prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1408; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd prefer to keep my name off this recording, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit.
Q: That's fine. We'll refer to you as the claimant. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Katy, Texas. I was turning left across the lanes to get into a shopping center.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had stopped at the light, waited for the oncoming traffic to clear, and then started my turn when the signal allowed it.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming until right before it struck.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbags deployed, and I was pushed against the seat and the door.
Q: Did you receive medical attention?
A: I was taken to an urgent care clinic that evening. They checked my neck and lower back and said I had strains.
Q: Describe your symptoms since the collision.
A: My neck is stiff, and turning my head to the left is painful. My lower back aches when I sit for long periods. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and using a heating pad.
Q: Have you missed any work because of these injuries?
A: I've been off for a few days and I'm working modified duties now. I'm still seeing my doctor for follow-up appointments.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'd like to know what the next steps are for my claim.
Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with you about those next steps.
A: Thank you.
